chunks: about the leftover of a Jew or a Christian: may it be eaten from or drunk?

key_terms.سُؤْرِ: leftover food or drink remaining after someone has used it
key_terms.لَا: no; it is not permitted in this report

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat or drink from the leftover of a Jew or a Christian according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling in response to a question about consuming the leftover food or drink of a Jew or a Christian. The Imam عليه السلام replies in the negative, indicating prohibition in this context.
